name: time
description: Time of the reading as exported; local clock, time zone unconfirmed

name: machine
description: TBM number from the directory name

name: stream
description: Directory (and part) the file came from

name: project
description: Project named in the directory; 未标明 when it names none

name: file_status
description: P0 status of the source file

name: source_id
description: Index of the source file in file_audit.csv / source_files.csv

name: row
description: 0-based row number in the source file

name: F
description: Total thrust

name: T
description: Cutterhead torque

name: n
description: Cutterhead speed after repair (see n_source)

name: v
description: Advance speed

name: p
description: Penetration per revolution

name: n_source
description: exported, repaired_v_over_p, repaired_drive_speed, unrecoverable or missing

name: state_boring
description: The machine's own boring flag (TBM8: advance state); empty where the export has none

name: state_cutter
description: Cutterhead working state code

name: state_thrust
description: Thrust working state code

name: state_regrip
description: Re-gripping state

name: dt_prev_s
description: Seconds since the previous reading of the machine

name: active
description: F, T, n and v all above zero

name: valid_core
description: No hard flag: not q_neg, q_core_missing, q_v_high, q_T_high, q_F_high, q_v_invalid_file or q_time_conflict

name: q_time_backward
description: Time is earlier than the previous row of the file

name: q_time_coarse
description: File has timestamps only to the minute (P0)

name: q_time_conflict
description: Another reading of the machine has the same timestamp and different values

name: q_neg
description: A core signal is negative

name: q_core_missing
description: F, T, n or v is empty (also where the export has no such column)

name: q_n_invalid
description: Exported n is not a rotation speed (above the rpm limit, or as large as the drive-motor speed)

name: q_v_high
description: v above 250 mm/min

name: q_T_high
description: T above 12000

name: q_F_high
description: F above 60000

name: q_pnv_off
description: p*n/v outside 0.5 to 2 where v, p and n are large enough to be read

name: q_v_invalid_file
description: P0 found v and p of the whole file unusable

name: seg_no
description: Number of the P2 segment the row lies in (index into segments_v1/segments.csv, same machine); -1 outside every segment

name: phase
description: P2 phase: 0 outside a segment, 1 ramp, 2 steady, 3 end, 4 inside a segment without a named phase

name: op_state
description: P2 operating state: 0 boring (inside a segment), 1 cutterhead turning without boring, 2 cutterhead not turning, 3 cutterhead speed missing

name: view_boring
description: Row lies in a segment of the continuous-boring view: long, phase_status ok (a steady phase was found) and not stalled

name: view_strict
description: Row lies in a segment of the continuous-boring view whose two edges are both observed (neither is censored by a data hole or the end of the series)

name: view_steady
description: Row is in the steady phase (phase 2) of a segment of the continuous-boring view

name: run_id
description: Number of the run of consecutive valid_core rows, no two neighbours more than 60 s apart, within the machine series; -1 where valid_core is false

name: win30_pos
description: Row position (0-based, in this file) of the target of the 30 s window that starts at this row (origin), -1 where no window starts here: the origin is active, the origin and the 3 rows before it and the target row are valid_core rows of one run, and the target is the first reading at or after origin+30 s, at most 5 s late

name: win30_level
description: Level of that window: 0 none, 1 full-run view, 2 also continuous-boring view (all rows of the window inside one boring-view segment), 3 also steady view (first history row and target in the steady phase of it)

name: win60_pos
description: Row position (0-based, in this file) of the target of the 60 s window that starts at this row (origin), -1 where no window starts here: the origin is active, the origin and the 3 rows before it and the target row are valid_core rows of one run, and the target is the first reading at or after origin+60 s, at most 5 s late

name: win60_level
description: Level of that window: 0 none, 1 full-run view, 2 also continuous-boring view (all rows of the window inside one boring-view segment), 3 also steady view (first history row and target in the steady phase of it)

name: win120_pos
description: Row position (0-based, in this file) of the target of the 120 s window that starts at this row (origin), -1 where no window starts here: the origin is active, the origin and the 3 rows before it and the target row are valid_core rows of one run, and the target is the first reading at or after origin+120 s, at most 5 s late

name: win120_level
description: Level of that window: 0 none, 1 full-run view, 2 also continuous-boring view (all rows of the window inside one boring-view segment), 3 also steady view (first history row and target in the steady phase of it)
